name: opencode-fastdraw
description: Quick-draw model switching for opencode agents — bind models to roles/agents from the TUI, snapshot them as presets, preview, share, and hot-swap instantly
author: TachikomaGundam

scripts.pretest: esbuild server.ts --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --external:@opencode/plugin --external:@opencode/plugin/tui --external:solid-js --outfile=test/.build/server.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild origins.ts --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --outfile=test/.build/origins.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild omo.ts --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --outfile=test/.build/omo.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild home-reach.ts --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --outfile=test/.build/home-reach.mjs --log-level=error && esbuild tui.ts --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --external:@opencode/plugin --external:@opencode/plugin/tui --external:solid-js --outfile=test/.build/tui.mjs --log-level=error
scripts.test: node test/preset.test.mjs && node test/preset-split.test.mjs && node test/origins.test.mjs && node test/omo.test.mjs && node test/omo-routing.test.mjs && node test/home-reach.test.mjs && node test/import-picker.test.mjs && node test/v2-server-entry.test.mjs && node test/v2-tui-entry.test.mjs && node test/v2-tools-core.test.mjs
